package.name: umiusi_autonomy
package.description: Deploy-side ROS 2 nodes for UMIUSI autonomous balloon popping. perception_node runs the learned balloon detector on the onboard camera and publishes typed detections; navigator_node runs the shared behaviour FSM and drives the sinsei_umiusi_control thrusters over the direct-override topics. Both are THIN rclpy wrappers around the ROS-free umiusi_perception Python package, so the same perception + autonomy code runs in simulation (tools/autonomy_run) and on the robot.
